from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCase(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single legal judgment document summary."""
    document_id: str | None = Field(description="The identifier or title of the judgment document (e.g., '判决文书 15')")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action (案由) defined in the document")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The general legal nature of the case (e.g., Civil, Criminal, Administrative)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentCase]
